topic: The balance between Israeli West Bank security infrastructure and Palestinian freedom of movement
neutral_claim: The Israeli administration maintains an integrated network of physical barriers, separation walls, and internal checkpoints to monitor movement and mitigate militancy. This infrastructure is maintained as a protective mechanism to ensure the safety of Israeli citizens, while concurrently restricting the daily mobility, economic self-sufficiency, and individual dignity of the adjacent Palestinian population living alongside the perimeter.
